gameInfo.title: Goblin Slayer — Persistent Goblin Sandbox
lossConditions: Complete loss of the house and captive without escape

player.name: Unnamed
player.description: An ordinary adult male goblin who has undergone months of intense physical conditioning. Now significantly stronger, faster, and more enduring than a typical goblin, with denser muscle and sharper combat drills. Has learned basic common tongue.
player.position: Occupant of isolated frontier house with captive

stats.notes: Body hardened by daily lifts, sprints, and striking drills. Speed and endurance markedly improved. Still goblin-scale.

inventory.name: Bone Knife
inventory.description: Crude bone knife shaped earlier, kept sharp enough.

knowledge: Basic common tongue vocabulary and simple grammar

captive-woman.notes: Months of captivity, care, sex, and language exchange. She shows automatic arousal responses, cooks, follows, and accepts use without active resistance. Residual shame present but dulled. No full affection.

Isolated Frontier House.name: Isolated Frontier House
Isolated Frontier House.description: Small timber house with thatched roof in a forest clearing. Lived-in after months of occupation. Hearth, rough table, bed, storage. Cold ash of burned body remains at clearing edge.

tribe.name: Original Nest (left behind)
tribe.notes: Player has been absent for months. Status unknown.

eventsLog: Player left nest, hunted, reached isolated house, killed male occupant, took woman captive.
Months of training, sex, conditioning, and language learning at the house.
Body significantly conditioned. Basic common tongue acquired. Dependence deepened.

captive-woman.name: Unnamed Woman
captive-woman.description: Adult human woman, former occupant of the house. After months of captivity: passive acceptance, automatic physical responses to player, cooks and maintains basic household tasks, teaches common tongue. Residual shame, no active resistance or clear affection.

history: Early turns: Left nest, hunted, reached house, killed man, took woman.
Extended period: Training, repeated sexual use, edging, care, language lessons over ~3 months.
Current: Basic common tongue functional. Body conditioned. Relationship of deepened dependence.
